title: Electroacupuncture reduces duration of postoperative ileus after laparoscopic surgery for colorectal cancer.
companion_identifiers: NCT00464425; possible related interim/companion Covidence records #2470, #2625 and #4322
evidence_summary: Randomized adult colorectal-surgery EA trial under general anaesthesia with separable sham/no-acupuncture comparators and clinical recovery outcomes; retained and flagged because postoperative day 1 does not resolve the <=24-hour timing threshold.
notes: NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW - UNCERTAIN_TIMING. Possible companion reports are recorded but not merged.

title: Effects of Transcutaneous Electrical Acupoint Stimulation (TEAS) on Postoperative Recovery in Patients with Gastric Cancer: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
companion_identifiers: ChiCTR1900022692; PMCID PMC7886100; exact duplicate citation appears as Covidence #1141
evidence_summary: Randomized adult gastrectomy trial under general anaesthesia with separable therapeutic TEAS and eligible clinical outcomes; retained and flagged because POD1 treatment timing does not resolve the <=24-hour threshold.
notes: NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW - UNCERTAIN_TIMING. Exact duplicate #1141 should not be screened independently.

title: The Effect of Acupuncture on Relieving Pain after Inguinal Surgeries.
companion_identifiers: PMCID PMC3546210; exact duplicate citation appears as Covidence #1556
evidence_summary: Randomized inguinal-surgery EA trial under explicit general anaesthesia with eligible preoperative electrical needle stimulation, inactive-current control and pain/opioid outcomes; retained and flagged because mixed adult/pediatric results are not separable.
notes: NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW - mixed adult/pediatric population. Exact duplicate #1556 should not be screened independently.

title: Needleless transcutaneous electrical acustimulation accelerates post-surgical recovery mediated via autonomic mechanisms in patients with gastrointestinal cancers.
companion_identifiers: Possible related pilot/full reports Covidence #3690 and #556; 32 gastrointestinal-cancer surgery patients
evidence_summary: Results-bearing randomized adult surgical conference report with therapeutic ST36/PC6 electrical acustimulation, non-acupoint sham and clinical recovery/pain outcomes; retained and flagged because GA and <=24-hour POD1 timing are unresolved.
notes: NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW - UNCERTAIN_GENERAL_ANAESTHESIA and UNCERTAIN_TIMING; possible companion publication.
